newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * Romania's President Emil Constantinescu has invited opposition leaders for talks this evening. Party of Social Democracy (PDSR) leader, ex-president Ion Iliescu, to attend.
* An economic Romanian-Italian forum started on Bucharest, where over 5,000 Italian entrepeneurs attending.
* Italian Foreign Trade Augusto Fantozzi said his country would support Romania's bid to join European structures, state radio said.

* The amount of over 1.8 trillion lei in state budget money allotted for transport in 1997 is not enough for investments, Transport Minister Traian Basescu told a news conference. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
